title: Armor Liner
description: Armor Liner adds removable warming and cooling liners for armor.
body:
Armor Liner adds removable warming and cooling liners for armor.
  - Apply liners with Tough As Nails wool and leaf armor pieces
  - Remove liners with Liner Snips
  - Recover the liner item when removing it
  - See the current liner type in the armor tooltip
  - Uses Tough As Nails-style temperature scaling for better balance
